hints.title: Infinite State Machine Iterator
hints.text: Generating an unbounded sequence on demand requires a generator function that yields successive terms while maintaining running recurrence state.

hints.title: State Transition with Two Variables
hints.text: Initialize two state variables to zero and one. In an infinite loop, yield the current leading value and advance the pair by setting the next value to their sum.

hints.title: Fibonacci Generator Blueprint
hints.text: Define generator function fibGenerator(). Let a = 0, b = 1. While true: yield a; [a, b] = [b, a + b].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Each yield operation executes in constant time using two numeric registers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Precomputing an array of numbers exhausts heap capacity for infinite sequences.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lazy evaluation produces values on demand with zero buffer memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Proficiency with generator syntax function* and the yield keyword.
